# the answers of the staged start lab, the staged form GB in each failing state and the references, one per line:
# block form state cell family answer, where F is a refusal by the down set's 32765, F5 by the catch-all refusal 5450, Fh by a
# hold, M the mesh, C the carve-out link, U out of the uplink by its default, U9, U8 and U7 by the operator's routes shorter and
# longer than the overlay and to a subnet outside it
# generated from the lab's logs by a script that turns each logged cell into its code, not written by hand
